hash_algorithm: Git blob SHA-1: SHA1("blob " + canonical byte length + NUL + canonical bytes); saved model SHA-256 is supplemental
scope: Entire pinned repository source preserved byte-for-byte, plus add-only Oct05 roster/checkpoint/workflow/root-guide paths.

portable_visual_review.scope: Local model-review bundle, separate from compact Git source; 70 views and 240 orbit frames plus ten proof JSONs.

excluded: Git metadata, credentials and browser/account sessions
Generated standalone HTML (rebuilt and separately pinned by CI)
verification_limits: Hash/structural checks do not certify perfect design, global manifoldness/intersections, deformation or gameplay integration.
